review: Combat/behavior episodes, sensory restrictions, pain tables, honor codes, temperature-dependent physiology and compulsions enumerated. Table boundaries, authored event contracts and runtime integration remain pending.

entries.acceptance: Persistent offensive odor is -10 and gives -2 reactions from most people/animals; masking perfume retains the same penalty. Author can define scavenger/pest attraction separately, not universal hostility from every creature.

Volatile temper is base -10 with self-control. A failed check in a stressful situation requires an authored hostile response toward the stressor. Preserve the specific trigger and player choices among qualifying responses.

Uncontrolled rage is base -10 with self-control. More than one quarter health capacity injured within one second, or witnessing equivalent injury to a loved one, prompts a check. Failed volatile-temper control automatically triggers rage. Voluntary entry takes concentration and successful will. Aggregate injuries in the one-second window rather than checking only each hit.

During rage, an in-range foe requires all-out attack with a hand weapon. Otherwise move as close as possible, using move-and-attack or a slam when possible. Enforce maneuver and defense consequences through the normal turn ledger.

A foe more than twenty yards away permits a ranged attack without aim. Firearms use maximum firing rate until empty; reloading is allowed only when the weapon and quick-draw capability permit completion in at most one second. Otherwise draw another weapon or charge. Preserve ammunition and actual reach/distance.

Rage prevents shock/stun and injury movement penalties, and grants +4 health to stay conscious/alive. Injury still accumulates and death occurs at negative five times health capacity. On leaving rage, wounds immediately apply and ordinary health consciousness/survival checks are required. Resolve overlaps with other survival traits explicitly.

Each downed foe permits optional self-control to exit; failure or declining continues to another foe. Restraining friends count as foes. Once no foes remain, one extra check is available; continued failure turns aggression toward friends. Store episode and downed-target event identity so repeated narration cannot grant extra recovery checks.

Combat-triggered rage increases the disadvantage magnitude by +50% and requires self-control on first entering any combat, even without injury. Apply self-control pricing and modifier rounding consistently.

Animalistic behavior is normally -10, or -15 for especially repugnant behavior by author decision. Author defines barred civilized-art/social skills and defaults. Territorial/dominance relationships may exist; low intelligence is not inherent. Do not charge a second offensive-habit drawback for the same included behavior.

Blindness is -50. Adapted combat skills take -6, cannot select hit locations and restrict ranged attacks to random fire or nearby audible targets. Sudden sight loss takes -10 instead. Darkness adds no further penalty. Author defines navigational assistance and infeasible visual actions without denying valid nonvisual sensing.

Reject visual powers with blindness; exclusive infrared/ultraviolet sight is its zero-point alternate-sense feature instead. Active scanning and vibration are nonvisual and can coexist, using their own targeting rules. Do not apply blindness penalties again when a specific valid alternate-sense procedure replaces them.

Lethal hostility is base -10 with self-control. Legitimate enemies prompt killing blows and confirmation of downed foes; surrender, stealth bypass or capture needs successful self-control to avoid attempting to kill. Author defines enemy classification; ordinary nonlethal quarrels are not automatically murderous.

Bullying is base -10 with self-control and -2 reactions. A failed restraint check requires authored coercive/harassing behavior where the actor believes it feasible. Preserve applicable social consequences and do not automatically inflict physical damage.

Callousness is -5: teaching and helpful psychology take -3, as do interactions with past victims identified by author. Victims/empaths react at -1. Threat/torture-based interrogation and intimidation gain +1. These bonuses are scoped fictional mechanics, not blanket social skill increases.

Inability to learn is -30 and bars earned-point improvement of dexterity, intelligence, skills and mental advantages, plus new techniques/familiarities. Strength/health and approved physical traits remain eligible. Temporary modular skills are allowed. Apply at advancement assessment, not only character creation.

No articulated speech is -15 but permits nonlinguistic vocal sounds and compatible voice/imitation traits, excluding stuttering. Total muteness is -25 and forbids all other voice traits; nonverbal channels remain. Communication study time counts fully without duplicating time spent.

For nonshared signing between player characters, the source requires authored communication rather than a success roll. Provide explicit conveyed meaning/gesture choices with no random roll; a generic callback alone does not establish the contract.

Compelled assistance is base -15 with self-control. When aid is possible/requested but should be resisted, failure requires an offer of help even to enemies or despite orders. Author identifies available assistance and consequences without inventing resources the actor lacks.

Persistent low motivation is base -15 with self-control. Outside minimum survival necessities, decisions or initiative require a check; failure selects the least-effort course, often inactivity or following a demanding companion. Implement this printed fictional behavior as an authored choice constraint, not a clinical model.

Author may replace low motivation with an equal-value drawback after supported development, possibly retaining both behaviors during transition. It may replace a broken self-imposed commitment or lost-dependent drawback. Reconcile point value and transition state once without granting new creation credit.
Recurrent pain severity mild has base -5, applying -2 to dexterity, intelligence and self-control during an awake episode. Sleep episodes instead cause sleep deprivation under the rest rules.
Recurrent pain severity severe has base -10, applying -4 to dexterity, intelligence and self-control during an awake episode. Sleep episodes instead cause sleep deprivation under the rest rules.
Recurrent pain severity agonizing has base -15, applying -6 to dexterity, intelligence and self-control during an awake episode. Sleep episodes instead cause sleep deprivation under the rest rules.
Pain interval 1 hours multiplies severity cost by 1/2. At each interval end health success ends pain for that day; failure continues another interval. Persist due time and recovery checks.
Pain interval 2 hours multiplies severity cost by 1/1. At each interval end health success ends pain for that day; failure continues another interval. Persist due time and recovery checks.
Pain interval 4 hours multiplies severity cost by 3/2. At each interval end health success ends pain for that day; failure continues another interval. Persist due time and recovery checks.
Pain interval 8 hours multiplies severity cost by 2/1. At each interval end health success ends pain for that day; failure continues another interval. Persist due time and recovery checks.

Daily pain frequency 6 multiplies cost by 1/2; drop final fractional magnitude. Table says at-or-below while narrative says below: preserve this boundary inconsistency for explicit resolution. Author selects episode start during the day after the single daily roll.

Daily pain frequency 9 multiplies cost by 1/1; drop final fractional magnitude. Table says at-or-below while narrative says below: preserve this boundary inconsistency for explicit resolution. Author selects episode start during the day after the single daily roll.

Daily pain frequency 12 multiplies cost by 2/1; drop final fractional magnitude. Table says at-or-below while narrative says below: preserve this boundary inconsistency for explicit resolution. Author selects episode start during the day after the single daily roll.

Daily pain frequency 15 multiplies cost by 3/1; drop final fractional magnitude. Table says at-or-below while narrative says below: preserve this boundary inconsistency for explicit resolution. Author selects episode start during the day after the single daily roll.

Companionship preference is -5, usually improving owner reactions to others by +2 and imposing intelligence-based skill -1 while alone. Strong dependence is -10, owner reactions +4, skill -2 alone or -1 in groups of four or fewer. Clarify whether the group count includes the owner; these are owner reactions, not others reactions toward them.

Social obliviousness is -10, gives +4 against seduction, -4 etiquette and usually -2 others reactions. Recognizing oneself as a verbal-joke target needs intelligence-4. It does not generally worsen resistance to fast talking outside the specified romantic misunderstanding. Author defines the social evidence and exceptions.

Honor code costs -5 informal among peers, -10 formal among peers or informal always, -15 formal always or extreme breach consequences. Author defines concrete obligations and scope, distinct from employment duty or personal duty to others. Mere claimed adherence is insufficient.

Printed code pattern peer-solidarity is -5 and requires an authored rule set covering peer loyalty, redress of insults and fair open conflict within the group. Record breach events and permitted responses, not just a label. Source-specific social assumptions remain authored setting facts.

Printed code pattern professional is -5 and requires an authored rule set covering professional ethics, competent work and support of the professional association. Record breach events and permitted responses, not just a label. Source-specific social assumptions remain authored setting facts.

Printed code pattern formal-peer is -10 and requires an authored rule set covering keeping promises, answering specified insults and fair contests among the defined social peers. Record breach events and permitted responses, not just a label. Source-specific social assumptions remain authored setting facts.

Printed code pattern service is -10 and requires an authored rule set covering unit loyalty, role-specific care, lawful orders and authored combat conduct. Record breach events and permitted responses, not just a label. Source-specific social assumptions remain authored setting facts.

Printed code pattern protective is -15 and requires an authored rule set covering formal honor extended to protection of vulnerable people, allegiance and rank-dependent challenges. Record breach events and permitted responses, not just a label. Source-specific social assumptions remain authored setting facts.

Ambient-dependent metabolism is -5 with threshold fifty Fahrenheit or -10 with sixty-five. It gives health+2 against temperature effects and one third ordinary food need. After thirty minutes cold exposure, or one hour with any thermal tolerance, lose one basic speed/dexterity per ten degrees below threshold. Preserve exposure and recovery history.

Below freezing, health failure causes one injury; warm clothing grants +2. The text does not specify a repeating damage-check interval: record as unresolved against the hazard chapter. Restore one lost basic speed/dexterity per warm hour, doubled in authored exceptional warmth; do not heal unrelated attribute losses.

Total color blindness is -10. Color-dependent tasks need authored restrictions; most art, chemistry, driving, merchant, piloting and tracking checks take -1. It does not reduce all vision indiscriminately, and inaccessible color evidence must not leak through descriptions.

Combat freezing is -15, adds -2 to fear checks and is incompatible with reflexes. At the decisive imminent-danger action, health check succeeds only on thirteen or less. Failure causes mental stun; each subsequent second permits health with cumulative +1, with a friend slap adding +1. After recovery, do not retrigger until that immediate danger ends.

Compulsive behavior is base -5 to -15 with self-control and requires daily indulgence when possible, plus opportunity-trigger checks. Entering a situation preventing indulgence for over a day requires self-control; if entered or forced, temporary volatile temper uses the same rating throughout. Own deprivation state and avoid duplicate permanent trait purchases.

Compulsive social revelry is base -5, or -10 in a strict setting. Seek at least one hour social gathering daily, with authored spending/opportunity behavior. Similar enthusiasts react +1, sober observers -1 or worse and strict observers -4. Consume actual time/resources, not a narrative-only flag.

Compulsive gambling is base -5 and seeks games/wagers without granting skill. If prevented, repeated persuasion causes reaction penalty of one per five negative points after self-control pricing. Define fractional penalty handling and interaction history explicitly.

Compulsive generosity is base -5, incompatible with stinginess, and triggers self-control on plausible aid stories. In a setting with many requests, living cost increases twenty/fifteen/ten/five percent at self-control six/nine/twelve/fifteen. Author may grant favorable reactions from charitable observers; no gift can spend unavailable funds.

Compulsive lying is base -15. Telling unembellished truth requires self-control; failure produces authored falsehood. Checks involving fellow characters remain private so outcome does not itself reveal truthfulness. Keep known facts separate from expressed claims.

Compulsive spending is base -5, incompatible with stinginess but compatible with greed. A relevant purchase offer triggers self-control only when available pocket cash is strictly more than twice price. Failure buys it. Living-cost increases are eighty/forty/twenty/ten percent and bargaining penalties -4/-3/-2/-1 at ratings six/nine/twelve/fifteen.

Compulsive vow-making is base -5 and adds solemn authored commitments, including incidental promises. Track actual vows, fulfillment and consequences; do not automatically grant additional negative points for every generated commitment.

Stimulus confusion is base -10 with self-control. Author supplies unfamiliarity/commotion modifier, ranging from ordinary situations to severe battle stimuli. Failure prevents decisive initiative. In combat use do-nothing but no stun penalty; direct attacks allow ordinary defense and counterattack against that foe. Track episode and reactive permission.

Physical-danger avoidance is base -10 with self-control, at -5 for risking death. Failure refuses danger unless a greater threat compels it. Physical-danger fear checks take -4/-3/-2/-1 at ratings six/nine/twelve/fifteen; informed relevant occupational observers may react similarly.
entries.validation_note: Rated purchase, owned physical-risk trigger, death-risk modifier, explicit greater-threat permissions and fear-context penalty derivation implemented. Matrix, replay, rollback, undo and continuation assertions authored, unrun. Occupational reactions now use explicit observer knowledge and setting facts, deriving the purchased penalty once through shared reaction/Diplomacy handling. Matrix and invalid-before-RNG assertions authored, unrun. Dynamic threat changes and parser/dialogue integration remain incomplete.

entries.acceptance: Compulsive curiosity is base -5 with self-control and prompts investigation of interesting unfamiliar situations despite known risk. Judgment-warning traits do not remove the urge. Author offers concrete investigative actions with ordinary costs and consequences instead of revealing hidden contents automatically.
entries.validation_note: Rated trait, concrete occurrence choices, owned self-control, action permission and completion contract implemented. Cabinet-action fixture covers normal time cost, replay, rollback, undo and saved pending obligations; assertions unrun. Broader story-action integration and parser/dialogue parity remain incomplete.

entries.acceptance: Severe misfortune curse is -75 and requires authored adverse events that preferentially affect the actor. Buyoff needs identifying/resolving the curse and paying points. Define event selection, consequences and source resolution; a generic random penalty callback is not completed implementation.

Deafness is -20, excludes auditory information and allows writing/signing or other viable channels. Communication time counts fully toward applicable skill study, through the single time ledger. Reconcile sound-dependent powers individually and do not remove nonauditory perception.
